app.name: STL2STP
onboarding.1.title: Turn STL into editable CAD files
onboarding.1.body: Import an STL mesh and convert it to STEP or IGES in one tap, then keep editing in SolidWorks, FreeCAD and more.
onboarding.2.title: Done in three steps
onboarding.2.step1: Import: from Files, WeChat or QQ
onboarding.2.step3: Share or save: send to your computer or Files
onboarding.2.privacy: Everything is processed on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
home.title: STL2STP
home.drop_hint: or drop an STL file here
home.empty.title: No conversions yet
home.empty.body: Converted files appear here so you can share them again.
import.help.title: Import from WeChat / QQ
import.help.step1: Open the STL file in the chat
import.help.step2: Tap “…” at the top right, then “Open in Another App”
import.help.files: Or save it to Files first, then tap “Import STL File”.
preview.gesture_hint: Drag to rotate · Pinch to zoom · Double-tap to reset
preview.stats.unit_note: STL has no units; sizes are shown as stored (usually mm)
export.format.step.desc: Universal CAD format; opens as a solid. Recommended
export.format.iges.desc: Older format; opens as a set of surfaces
preset.title: Conversion
preset.strict.desc: Sewn solid, best for multiple parts, ~2× slower
advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.simplify.desc: Fewer faces = smaller file and faster conversion, with slight loss of detail
advanced.mode.original.desc: Same algorithm as the desktop version, fast
advanced.mode.sewing.desc: Sews faces into a solid; stricter, ~2× slower; recommended for multiple parts
advanced.merge.desc: Merges triangles on the same plane; much smaller files for flat parts
advanced.verify.desc: Re-reads the exported file to make sure it opens
advanced.verify.iges_na: Verification is not available for IGES
advanced.meta.desc: Written to the file header and shown in CAD file properties. Empty by default.
advanced.meta.author: Author
advanced.meta.iges_warn: IGES supports English (ASCII) characters only; others will be removed
warn.large.title: Large model
warn.large.body: {faces} faces. STEP output is estimated at {size} and {time}. Consider reducing faces first.
warn.iges.surfaces: IGES opens as surfaces in CAD and must be sewn to become a solid. Choose STEP if you need a solid.
converting.title: Converting
converting.keep_open: Keep the app open; switching away may interrupt conversion
cancel.confirm.title: Cancel conversion?
done.title: Conversion Complete
done.partial: {n} triangles could not be converted and were skipped
done.target_not_reached: Could not reduce further; reduced to {faces} faces
done.iges_surfaces: IGES opens as surfaces; sew them into a solid in your CAD app
done.tip_pc: To your computer: use WeChat File Transfer or AirDrop
history.title: History
history.note: History and files stay on this device and are removed with the app
error.format.title: Can’t read this file
error.format.body: It isn’t a valid STL file or it’s damaged. Make sure it was exported as STL.
error.empty.title: No usable faces
error.empty.body: The file opened but contains no triangles that can be converted.
error.too_big.title: Model too large
error.too_big.body: This model has {faces} faces, above this device’s limit (about {limit}). Reduce faces first or use the desktop version.
error.memory.title: Not enough memory
error.memory.body: The device ran out of memory. Reduce faces or close other apps and try again.
error.cancelled.title: Cancelled
error.cancelled.body: Conversion was cancelled. No file was created.
error.io.title: Can’t save the file
error.io.body: Storage may be full. Free up space and try again.
error.generic.title: Conversion failed
